You are the implementation owner for GitHub issue #118 in fengie/mhw-mods. Work only on credential-safe GUI input for Heaven Local Bridge.

Goal: a password/API key can originate from heaven2 and be entered on heaven without secret bytes ever appearing in the persisted GitHub queue/results/logs/controller state.

Rules:
- origin/main is canonical; relay branch is transport only. Do NOT use Remote Desktop Commander.
- Fresh worktree/branch bridge/secret-channel-v05 from latest origin/main.
- Threat-model current relay first. Implement the smallest secure architecture feasible in-repo. Prefer opaque one-time handles plus mutually authenticated encrypted local delivery / named-secret broker. Fail closed if secure channel absent.
- Explicit TTL, single-use/replay protection, destination binding, cleanup. Secret value must never be serialized to GitHub, stdout/stderr, audit logs, screenshots metadata, clipboard relay, controller checkpoints, or test fixtures.
- GUI secret entry must not echo the secret in results. Tests must prove a sentinel secret does not appear in persisted relay/log/result artifacts.
- Preserve existing v2 protocol and existing actions. Keep heaven2 as credential authority and heaven as execution target.
- Do not implement semantic UIA except minimal shared interfaces required for secret entry.
- Update docs/setup/recovery notes.
- Run bridge gates and git diff --check.
- Commit and push branch; do NOT merge main yourself. Final stdout: design summary, threat boundary, branch, commit SHA, changed files, exact tests/pass counts, any setup prerequisite.
